items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Now we first went to Mr. Sims' home where we first got together... Band rehearsal would come around 1 o'clock in the day

ctx.x: Well, he had a voice, a pleasing voice and he seemed to get to the people which is important.

Now, you want me to talk to you about Mr. Sims. His idea to get the kids together, keep them out of trouble, you know. I don't know what kind of trouble we could have gotten into in Webster Groves because that's a long time ago, you know. ...
